title: Year 7 Hero Speech Sentence Builder
purpose: A two-page sentence-builder board for a Year 7 English hero speech. The student adds words to a sentence bar, speaks the whole sentence, and uses opinion, reason, evidence, and repair language to rehearse a short spoken text.

teacherNotes.modeling: Model a complete chain: My hero is, a firefighter, I think they are, brave, then Reasons, because, they help others, then Speak. Accept partial sentences as valid drafting or rehearsal.
teacherNotes.evidence: sentence built in the message bar; opinion/because/example selection; speak-sentence use; repair (undo, start again) or help request
teacherNotes.customisation: The firefighter is demonstration content, not evidence from a class text. Replace the hero words with the class text, film or local hero; the student can spell any hero's name with the ABC keyboard on the first page.
teacherNotes.curriculum: Supports Year 7 English speaking/listening by giving access to opinion, reasoning and evidence language for a short hero speech, and by letting the student assemble and rehearse a whole sentence rather than single words.
teacherNotes.repair: Undo is bottom-middle on both content pages; Start again is on the Word endings page; Help is bottom-left everywhere.
teacherNotes.use: Use for planning, rehearsal or supported oral presentation. The student builds a sentence on one page, crosses to the describing-words page, then speaks the whole sentence. Do not treat the board as the student's full expressive system.

navigation.notes: Each page keeps Speak sentence, Help, and a navigation button so a gaze or switch user never needs more than nine targets on screen.

commentExamples: Build "I think they are brave because they help others." while you talk about the class text.
Model your own hero with ABC: "My hero is" + spell "nan" + "because they help others".
partnerCard.notes: Accept partial sentences as drafting. Opinion words are on My hero; reasons are on Reasons, one page turn away. The student can spell their own hero with ABC.

evidenceLog.consentNote: Off by default. Turn on only after the team and family agree, and only for the purpose in the evidence plan. Logs stay on this device in memory until exported.

sett.student: Secondary student can participate through AAC sentence starters, reasons, examples, describing words, and a spoken sentence without needing speech or handwriting as the only route.
sett.environment: English classroom or rehearsal setting with teacher/peer modelling, keyboard/touch/mouse/gaze access, and intermittent internet.
sett.task: Build, edit, and rehearse a short hero speech using opinion, because language, examples, and describing words across two calm pages.
sett.tools: Two-page sentence-builder grid (nine targets per page), a sentence/message bar, Speak sentence, Undo and Start again controls, spoken labels, text fallback, large targets, and stable repair buttons.

representation: running sentence in the message bar

differentiation.content: Keep Year 7 English opinion/evidence demand while reducing speech and memory load and making sentence construction visible.
differentiation.process: Model key vocabulary, provide wait time, allow rehearsal/repetition, accept partial sentences, and accept multimodal communication.
differentiation.product: Accept a built and spoken sentence, a partial sentence chain, rehearsal, teacher observation, or supported oral presentation evidence.
differentiation.environment: Use a calm, predictable, local-first layout with no more than nine targets per page and teacher controls separate from student choices.
differentiation.support: Teaching, SLP, OT, family, and student/team review should personalise vocabulary and access before reliance.

participationBarriers.barrier: Original speech task assumes spontaneous spoken sentences, fast verbal rehearsal, and holding a whole sentence in memory.
participationBarriers.support: Provide sentence stems, because/example buttons, describing words, a visible sentence bar, speak-whole-sentence, and repair options across two gaze-safe pages.

observable: sentence built in the message bar
evidencePlan.notJudgement: Prompting, navigation support, or access method should contextualise the speech evidence, not replace judgement about English content.
evidencePlan.export: Use anonymous teacher notes, print/portfolio evidence, or local CSV/report only when needed. Do not include diagnoses, behaviour details, family details, or school IDs.

provenance.sourcePrompt: Make a Year 7 English hero speech sentence-builder board.
